messages:
Ethan (acct): NewBridge sent an RFI — asks: feature parity table (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), POC pricing tiers, KMS/HSM options, cert rotation cadence, and an ops runbook. Need a buyer-friendly one-pager + short technical appendix. Can we get this by tomorrow morning?
Rina (solutions): Ill assemble the matrix. Quick callout: include streaming, embeddings, function-calling, kv-cache, and rollout controls (canary, A/B). Also add recommended POC artifacts: sample dataset, perf scripts, smoke tests.
Marco (infra): On failover: for Dedicated we support health-check driven failover with automatic routing to secondary region; expected RTO 30-90s depending on DNS. Active-active across continents not recommended without edge cache. For Private, depends on customer network and peering.
Tess (security): HSM: BYOK + HSM integrations for Dedicated and Private. Hosted: envelope encryption; customers can request key-rotation logs but not direct HSM M-of-N access. Rotation cadence: certs rotated every 90 days by default; customer keys rotate per their KMS settings.
Ethan (acct): Pricing suggestion for POC?
Rina (solutions): Options:
- Hosted pilot: $2k credit, 2 weeks (limited throughput)
- Dedicated short POC: 2-GPU pool, 2 weeks, $5k flat + usage
- Extended POC: 3 months reserved trial, 15% off reserved rate, engineering support included
Marco (infra): Network checklist to include: control-plane allowlist, optional VPC peering, IP ranges, and maintenance windows. We'll provide static egress manifest.
Tess (security): Add SOC2 line and FedRAMP timeline (in assessment). Also answer RFI item on audit logs: exportable to S3/GCS/Splunk; retention configurable up to 7 years for Dedicated/Private.
Ethan (acct): Great. Rina, attach "newbridge_rfi_matrix_v1.xlsx" and a one-page exec summary. I'll send once Tess + Marco sign off.
ci-bot: docs:rfp-preview build succeeded (sha: 9f4d2)
Rina (solutions): Uploading draft now. Will ping in 30 for signoff.
Marco (infra): Flag: if NewBridge demands FIPS HSM for Hosted, that's a blocker.
Tess (security): noted. We'll ask if they require FIPS for Hosted or just for Dedicated/Private.
Ethan (acct): Thanks team. Aim to finalize tonight. :rocket:
